issue.title: Ctrl+Space replay target is no longer refreshed from the submitted prompt
issue.description:
`+`/`Ctrl+Space` replays the last launch selection (src/sase/ace/last_agent_selection.py, `save_last_agent_selection_if_launchable`). One of its writers was `save_replayable_vcs_selection()` in `_launch_history.py`, which refreshed the replay target from the VCS ref the user actually cycled to with `<ctrl+p>` before submitting. That helper ran only from the discarded `proc_callable` launch body, so it was already dead in production; it was deleted with _launch_history.py in 65b72d43a (phase sase-ng.1.5).

RESULT: cycling `<ctrl+p>` to a different ref and submitting does not update what `Ctrl+Space` replays -- it keeps replaying whatever the picker/relaunch/quick-launch path last saved. The other writers (`_entry_quick_launch.py`, `_entry_relaunch.py`, `_entry_custom.py`) are all still live, so replay works; it is only the submit-time refresh that is missing.

SCOPE: the save mutates in-memory ACE state, so it cannot move into the spawned `sase run` child (that is why epic sase-ng.1 did not restore it). Do the refresh on the ACE side at submit time -- derive the selection from the prompt actually submitted in `_launch_resolved_prompt`/`_launch_start.py` and call `save_last_agent_selection_if_launchable()` there. Note the existing guards: the implicit `#git:home` default and non-launchable projects must not be saved (see the stale/implicit-default warnings in `_entry_points.py`). Deleted implementation is recoverable from 65b72d43a^:src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agent_workflow/_launch_history.py.

NOT caused by epic sase-ng.1 -- it deleted an already-unreachable copy and recorded this gap deliberately in its plan's 'Deliberately not restored here' section. Originating bead sase-ng; proposed by phase sase-ng.1.6.

RELATED: the VCS-xprompt MRU that feeds `<ctrl+p>` itself WAS restored onto the durable path in 97f5b6f03 (phase sase-ng.1.2), so `record_vcs_xprompt_usage` is fed correctly; only the Ctrl+Space replay target is stale.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-p6 — the other capability epic sase-ng.1 deliberately left unrestored when it deleted the unreachable in-process launch body; both are recoverable from the same deletion commits and share the ACE launch-submit surface (_launch_start.py / _launch_resolved_prompt).

payload.close_reason: Fixed by 19bdc94db (2026-08-20). _launch_start.py:288 calls _record_submit_time_vcs_replay(prompt) after a successful submit; that helper (lines 73-87) derives the VCS prefix from the prompt actually submitted and feeds record_vcs_xprompt_usage, which already drops the implicit #git:home default and non-launchable projects -- exactly the submit-time refresh the bead specified. Verified 2026-08-24 at 45806495f.
